title: Historic Stone Mansion Built 1859, 1960 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: This is the house that my Uncle Andrew Monteith built in 1859. It was a mansion then & looks good yet.
description: A March 1960 square black and white snapshot capturing a impressive two-story stone house with a curved gravel driveway in the foreground. Shadows from mature trees cover parts of the facade. The handwritten inscription on the back notes that the house was built in 1859 by Uncle Andrew Monteith, referring to Canadian businessman and politician Andrew Monteith, reflecting 19th-century architectural heritage preserved into the mid-20th century.
